intro.en: Marine project cables serve shipboard power, control and instrumentation routes.
intro.zh: 船舶项目电缆服务于船上动力、控制与仪表路径。

knowledge.en: Circuit, route zone, class rules, fire strategy and marine exposure must be coordinated.
knowledge.zh: 回路、路径区域、船级规则、防火策略与海洋暴露必须协同。

notes.en: Provide vessel, class, cable schedule, route, environment and evidence.
notes.zh: 请提供船舶、船级、电缆清册、路径、环境与证据。

delivery.en: Release records the exact marine construction and installation scope.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含准确船用结构与安装范围。

subtitle.en: Map every route from dry accommodation to exposed machinery spaces
subtitle.zh: 从干燥舱室到暴露机械区，逐段定义电缆路径

lead.en: Select each cable by circuit, location and project rules.
lead.zh: 按回路、位置与项目规则选择每条电缆。
